Package org.dellroad.muxable.simple

Class ProtocolWriter

java.lang.Object
org.dellroad.muxable.simple.LoggingSupport
org.dellroad.muxable.simple.ProtocolWriter
public class ProtocolWriter extends LoggingSupport
Output state machine for the SimpleMuxableChannel framing protocol.

Instances are not thread safe.

  • Method Details

    • openNestedChannel

      public long openNestedChannel(ByteBuffer requestData, Directions directions) throws IOException
      Open a new local nested channel.

      Because the channel was created by the local side, the returned channel ID will always be positive.

      Any generated output will delivered to the configured ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler synchronously (in the current thread). However, this method must not be invoked re-entrantly.

      Parameters:
      requestData - the request data to send to the remote side
      directions - which I/O direction(s) are being established (from the local point of view)
      Returns:
      the ID for the newly opened channel (always positive)
      Throws:
      IOException - if thrown by the ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler
      IllegalArgumentException - if either parameter is null
      IllegalStateException - if this method is invoked re-entrantly by the ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler
      IllegalStateException - if all 263 channel ID's have already been allocated

    • writeNestedChannel

      public boolean writeNestedChannel(long channelId, ByteBuffer data) throws IOException
      Send data on the nested channel with the specified channel ID.

      The specified nested channel may have already been closed (this can happen due to race conditions between the local side writing and the remote side closing); if so, no data is actually sent and this method returns false.

      Generated output, if any, will delivered to the configured ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler synchronously (in the current thread). However, this method must not be invoked re-entrantly.

      Parameters:
      channelId - encoded channel ID (positive for local channels, negative for remote channels)
      data - the data to send
      Returns:
      true if data was framed and written to the ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler, false if the channel has already been closed
      Throws:
      IOException - if thrown by the ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler
      IllegalArgumentException - if channelId is not a valid channel ID
      IllegalArgumentException - if data is null
      IllegalStateException - if closeConnection() has been invoked on this instance
      IllegalStateException - if this method is invoked re-entrantly by the ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler

    • closeNestedChannel

      public boolean closeNestedChannel(long channelId) throws IOException
      Close an open nested channel.

      This sends a "close connection" frame to the peer, unless we know the already peer knows the channel is closed.

      Generated output, if any, will delivered to the configured ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler synchronously (in the current thread). However, this method must not be invoked re-entrantly.

      Parameters:
      channelId - encoded channel ID (positive for local channels, negative for remote channels)
      Returns:
      true if a "close connection" frame was written to the ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler, false the peer already knows that the channel is closed
      Throws:
      IOException - if thrown by the ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler
      IllegalArgumentException - if channelId is not the ID of an open nested channel
      IllegalStateException - if closeConnection() has been invoked on this instance

    • closeConnection

      public void closeConnection() throws IOException
      Close the entire connection.

      This sends a "close connection" frame to the peer, which closes the overall connection and all nested channels.

      Generated output will delivered to the configured ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler synchronously (in the current thread). However, this method must not be invoked re-entrantly.

      Throws:
      IOException - if thrown by the ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler
      IllegalStateException - if this method is invoked re-entrantly by the ProtocolWriter.OutputHandler
      IllegalStateException - if this method has already been invoked on this instance
